description: This file defines enums, structs, and helper functions related to execution approvals, security policies, and allowlist management within the OpenClaw project. It includes mechanisms for handling security modes, user prompts, allowlist entries, validation, and state management, as well as actor-based caching for skill binaries.

classes.name: SkillBinsCache
classes.description: An actor that manages a cache of skill binary names and their resolved filesystem paths, refreshing data periodically by querying a skills status report.

classes.name: SkillBinTrustIndex
classes.description: A struct representing a trust index for skill binaries, comprising a set of bin names and a mapping from bin names to their resolved paths.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the 'exec-approvals.json' file in the application's state directory.

methods.name: socketPath
methods.description: Returns the socket path string for 'exec-approvals.sock'.

methods.name: normalizeIncoming
methods.description: Normalizes an incoming ExecApprovalsFile object, resolving legacy defaults and paths.

methods.name: readSnapshot
methods.description: Reads and returns a snapshot of the exec approvals file, including its hash.

methods.name: redactForSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a redacted version of the ExecApprovalsFile suitable for snapshot comparisons, removing sensitive info.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads the ExecApprovalsFile from disk, returning a default if loading fails.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves the provided ExecApprovalsFile to disk.

methods.name: ensureFile
methods.description: Ensures the exec-approvals file exists, creating or updating it as needed, and returns its current state.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the current exec approvals configuration for a given agentId, loading and normalizing the data.

methods.name: resolveReadOnly
methods.description: Reads the exec approvals configuration without writing or side effects, for background use.

methods.name: resolveFromFile
methods.description: Computes the resolved defaults and agent configuration from a given ExecApprovalsFile.

methods.name: resolveDefaults
methods.description: Returns the default exec approvals resolved configuration.

methods.name: saveDefaults
methods.description: Saves the given defaults configuration to the state file.

methods.name: updateDefaults
methods.description: Updates the defaults configuration with a custom mutation.

methods.name: saveAgent
methods.description: Stores an agent's configuration under a specified agent ID.

methods.name: addAllowlistEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist pattern to an agent after validation.

methods.name: recordAllowlistUse
methods.description: Records usage data for an allowlist pattern, updating last used command and path.

methods.name: updateAllowlist
methods.description: Replaces or removes allowlist entries, returning rejected entries due to invalid patterns.

methods.name: updateAgentSettings
methods.description: Modifies an agent's configuration with a custom mutation.

methods.name: ensureSecureStateDirectory
methods.description: Ensures the state directory exists with secure permissions.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random token string.

methods.name: hashRaw
methods.description: Creates a SHA256 hash of a raw string.

methods.name: hashFile
methods.description: Creates a SHA256 hash of a given ExecApprovalsFile.

methods.name: expandPath
methods.description: Expands a path string, handling '~' and relative paths.

methods.name: agentKey
methods.description: Generates a standardized key for an agent ID, defaulting if blank.

methods.name: normalizedPattern
methods.description: Validates and normalizes an allowlist pattern string.

methods.name: migrateLegacyPattern
methods.description: Converts legacy pattern entries to current format, attempting to fix invalid patterns.

methods.name: normalizeAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Normalizes a list of allowlist entries, optionally rejecting invalid patterns.

methods.name: mergeAgents
methods.description: Merges two agent configurations, combining allowlists without duplicates.
